facts.fact: YouTube requires generative AI disclosure when content makes a real person appear to say or do something they did not do, alters footage of a real event or place, or generates a realistic scene that never occurred.

facts.fact: On YouTube, the AI disclosure is made during upload in the Attributes section under the AI use setting.
